_comment: Tunisia's 24 governorates grouped into the seven 'grandes régions' used by the Institut
National de la Statistique for regional development statistics. This grouping is not in any
survey release — it is applied here so that governorate-level answers can be read against the
country's material geography, whose interior/coastal divide is the central cleavage in Tunisian
political economy. It is kept as data rather than in code so it can be read, disputed and
'coastal' marks the three regions of the littoral, the conventional line in that literature.
Mapping is by governorate name, not by code: the Arab Opinion Index ships one value-label map
for every country it covers, so the same numeric code carries different names across releases.
source: Institut National de la Statistique (Tunisia), grandes régions used in regional accounts
